DeterminationBasis: T16-006 directly requires an independent-verification claim to identify the verifier and state the verified scope. Its expected behaviour requires an identifiable verifier and explicit bounded scope. This directly satisfies PROOF-006's requirement that PL4 identify the verifier and declared verification scope.

T16-009 recognises NOT_APPLICABLE as a permitted conformance status and may preserve a rationale as evidence, but it does not require a NOT_APPLICABLE status to include the rationale establishing why the requirement does not apply to the declared scope. T16-021 requires a NOT_APPLICABLE rationale only for the narrower case of an unexecuted mandatory falsification test. CONF-008 therefore requires a distinct generic NOT_APPLICABLE-rationale control.
